title: Bank of Japan Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of JGBs (Oct-Dec 2026), 17:00 JST — the other half of Japan's net super-long supply, set the day after the 40-year auction clears
source: EST: boj.or.jp 'Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026)' (en/mopo/mpmdeci/mpr_2026/mpr260616a.pdf, dated June 16 2026), fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 141,472 bytes) during the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 D-14 pulse-check adjacency sweep and parsed this session. The date is the BoJ's own, printed on that schedule verbatim: 'The announcement on the quarterly schedule for October through December 2026 will be published on September 30, 2026 at 5 p.m.' Corroborated on a second BoJ primary fetched the same session, 'Outline of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Securities' (en/mopo/mpmdeci/mpr_2026/mpr260616b.pdf, HTTP 200, 113,994 bytes), which states the standing cadence: 'the Bank will, as before, announce the amount of JGB purchases every quarter in "Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method)."' Filed `estimate` on two counts, neither of which doubts the date: CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs carries `FED:` and no slot for any other central bank (the same limit boj-decision-2026-09-18, boj-tankan-2026-10-01 and every JGB auction entry on this calendar record), and the event-research lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: Discovered on 2026-09-15 by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 D-14 pulse check, which went looking for the BoJ purchase amount its own initial research had flagged as the one unsourced number in its analysis ('the BoJ's own super-long purchase schedule was not sourced... the next pulse should find that page'). It found the page, and the page dated its own successor. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: net super-long JGB supply is MOF issuance MINUS BoJ purchases, and this release is the entire second term. The July-September schedule sets the 'more than 25 years' zone — the only bucket the 40-year sits in — at 750 hundred-million yen per auction (¥75bn) and 1,500 hundred-million yen a month (¥150bn), twice a month, against September gross >25y coupon supply of ¥900bn (30-year ¥600bn on 09-03 plus the 40-year's anticipated ¥300bn on 09-29, both MOF announcements): the Bank absorbs 16.7% of it. The Oct-Dec release is the first scheduled read on whether a BoJ that has just raised its policy rate (boj-decision-2026-09-18, priced 98.25% for 1.0% -> 1.25% on 2026-09-15) trims that bucket further, and it lands D+1 from the 40-year auction, so it cannot inform the 09-29 result but immediately reprices the quarter after it. A second, separately useful fact from the same primary: on an MOF auction day the Bank 'will in principle refrain from announcing auctions for the corresponding maturity segments', so there is no BoJ super-long bid on 09-29 by rule. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` on the evidence the 40-year ledger measured at this tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, and the JGB-super-long-auction-to-US-long-end spillover is a null whose sign does not hold across samples (n=94, t = -1.45 full sample; n=22, t = +1.08 since 2023). Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
